Steve ran a cable with a camera from the kitchen stack approximately 40 feet through the line with a chain cutter, and successfully removed a large amount of hardened grease and debris. After the cleaning, the sewer line was clear and flowing freely.

Throughout the entire process, Steve was very professional and took the time to explain in detail how everything worked. To my surprise, I was charged only for the cleaning service, and the price was even lower than what we paid back in 2019.

I cannot thank Steve enough for his excellent work and honesty. I highly recommend this company.
